entities.summary: Batu Khan's destruction of Kyiv (December 6, 1240) — a catastrophe that reduced the city to ruins. The Mongol/Golden Horde domination of the southern steppe, while the principality of Galicia-Volhynia maintained a degree of independence under Daniel of Halych.
